_howToUpdate: This file drives evolveDiscipleshipTraining.html. Edit this file only; the page never needs to change for a new session.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in Milwaukee time. A session shows as OPEN from registrationOpens through the end of the registrationCloses day, then disappears on its own.
registrationOpens is optional. Leave it out and the session is open right away until it closes. If it is a future date, the class shows under Opening Soon.
registrationCloses and formUrl are required for a session to appear.
startDate, schedule, and format are optional details shown on the card.
Set hidden to true to pull a session early, for example if the class fills up.
To add a new round, add a new object to that course's sessions list. Old sessions can stay; expired ones are ignored.
Preview any date by opening the page with ?preview=2026-09-10 on the end of the GitHub Pages URL.
